items.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
items.summary: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay upfront, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.
items.creator: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
items.summary: Fractile has now become one of the top-funded players in the race for purpose-built AI chips.
items.creator: Anna Heim

items.title: Congress to call Jensen Huang in to answer for alleged Chinese spy affair
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has until the end of the day Wednesday to answer a call from House Republicans for a closed-door briefing on his affair with alleged Chinese spy.
items.creator: Rebecca Bellan
